page.content:
Red Bull champion of the 2020s, title-decided in Abu Dhabi 2021.

How Max Verstappen connects

  • Faction: Red Bull Racing — Max Verstappen is Red Bull Racing's 2020s champion.
  • Character: Lewis Hamilton — Verstappen took the 2021 title from Hamilton on the last lap in Abu Dhabi.
  • Item: World Drivers' Championship — Verstappen's title run is the Drivers' Championship of the 2020s.

What is Max Verstappen?

Max Verstappen took the 2021 Drivers' Championship from Lewis Hamilton on the last lap in Abu Dhabi, then turned Red Bull Racing into a second-era dynasty.

Key threads lead to Red Bull Racing, Lewis Hamilton and World Drivers' Championship.
